news.headline:
At its 38th AGM, Ambika Cotton Mills reported FY26 revenue from operations of ~₹781.0 crore, up ~11%, and profit after tax of ₹71.6 crore, up ~8.9%.

The company remains debt-free, with exports reaching ~₹545.5 crore. Additionally, it plans to modernize Unit 4 with an investment of ~₹135-138 crore, targeting completion by March 2027.

Source: ScoutQuest

news.headline:
Suzuki Motor has directed Indian suppliers to halt production one day weekly for maintenance as Maruti Suzuki aims to boost annual output from 2.4 million to 4 million cars by 2030.

The planned 6-day, 20-hour operational model aims to curb breakdowns and maintain quality amid rising competition from Tata Motors and Mahindra, though suppliers may face extra capacity costs.

Source: Money Control

DhanSafal Finserve forfeited 3,69,20,000 unexercised convertible warrants after the conversion window lapsed on October 1, 2026. Out of 8,66,20,000 warrants originally allotted at an issue price of Rs 4.4 per warrant, 4,97,00,000 warrants were successfully converted into equity shares.

The company forfeited upfront warrant money totaling Rs 3,97,81,300. While the paid-up equity share capital remains unchanged, potential dilution of the company's equity share capital stands reduced.

Source: BSE

Adani Ports handled 46 MMT cargo in Sep'26, up 11% YoY, driven by 15% growth in containers. H1 FY27 cargo volume grew 15% YoY to 280 MMT, led by 15% gains in both containers and dry cargo.

Logistics rail volume reached 62,302 TEUs in Sep'26 (+3% YoY) and 312,763 TEUs in H1 FY27 (-13% YoY). The update reflects operational performance and does not include revenue or profit figures.

Source: ScoutQuest

news.headline:
Punjab National Bank reported a 12% YoY surge in global business to Rs 31.2 lakh crore in Q2, while domestic business rose 10.8% to Rs 29.7 lakh crore. Global advances grew by 14.8% YoY to Rs 13.4 lakh crore.

The bank's global deposits increased 9.9% YoY to Rs 17.8 lakh crore, and domestic deposits grew 9.4% to Rs 17.1 lakh crore. Meanwhile, domestic advances recorded a 12.6% YoY growth, reaching Rs 12.6 lakh crore.

Source: NDTV Profit

news.headline:
Maharashtra FDA revoked the drug sale and distribution licences of Cipla Pharma & Life Sciences' warehouse in Pune, citing lapses in packaging, storage, record-keeping, and inventory management following a review under Bombay High Court directives.

Key violations included misbranding of Schedule H drug Reactin Plus, medicines stored directly on floors, improper handling of expired drugs, and discrepancies between physical stock and SAP records.

Source: NDTV Profit
